title: Gradient estimates and Liouville theorems for the \(Φ\)-Laplacian equations on Riemannian manifolds
summary: This paper establishes gradient estimates and Liouville-type theorems for the \(Φ\)-Laplacian equation \(Δ_Φ(u) = G(|\nabla u|^2)\) on complete Riemannian manifolds and its parabolic counterpart \(\partial_t u = Λ_Φ(u)\) on compact Riemannian manifolds. Using a nonlinear \(Φ\)-Bochner formula and the Nash-Moser iteration technique, we prove local gradient bounds under the lower bound assumption of Ricci curvature and suitable conditions on \(Φ\) and \(G\), which leads to Liouville theorems for global solutions.
